get_metric_value_by_full_name: get the metric value using a full name indicator like 'COCO/AP' from evaluation results
get_metric_value_by_short_name: get the metric value using a short name indicator like 'AP' from evaluation results
test_get_metric_value_exact_match: test get_metric_value with a full name indicator that matches a key in the metrics dict
test_get_metric_value_suffix_match: test get_metric_value with a short name indicator that matches the suffix of a metrics key
test_get_metric_value_no_match: test get_metric_value raises ValueError when the indicator matches no metrics in the dict
